_comment: Omens (RunState.gd): optional run modifiers picked when you set out. Each makes the expedition harder and adds its reward bonus (gold and material counts from waves and Breathers). Effects: enemy_damage_mult, enemy_hp_mult, enemy_agility_mult (x), elite_chance_add (+), break_hits_delta (+/- hits to Break, everyone), gear_drop_mult (x), link_gain_mult (x), hide_weaknesses (true).

thin_veil.name: Thin Veil
thin_veil.description: Elites appear far more often, and enemies drop more gear.

brittle.name: Brittle
brittle.description: Breaking takes one fewer hit - for you too.

discord.name: Discord
discord.description: The Link gauge fills half as fast.

dim_sight.name: Dim Sight
dim_sight.description: Enemy weaknesses stay hidden, even ones you know.
